semiconductor_relevance: High — Hubei Evergrace specializes in ultra high purity gas purification systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hubei Evergrace Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures ultra high purity industrial gas purification equipment essential for semiconductor production. Their systems effectively remove impurities from various gases, ensuring compliance with stringent semiconductor industry standards.
capabilities: Ultra high purity gas purification systems

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Huangshi city, Hubei province, focusing on high-end electronic information equipment manufacturing.
